about: The states of a disk and of a copy, and what moves one to another, as specs.md says. states_test.go keeps them equal to the closed lists of schema/migrations and of specs.md §4, each transition to a state, and each bug to an entry of DONE.md that fixed it, or to a flaw of README.md, open or fixed.

transitions.label: disk add
transitions.when: `disk add`, the identity, topology and mount point checked

transitions.label: spun down
transitions.when: the daemon's check finds a whole disk in standby, waking none

transitions.label: spinning
transitions.when: its counters moved, it has requests under way, or it answers spinning

transitions.label: check fails, or EIO
transitions.when: a mount check fails, its own marker gone (no-marker) included, or an I/O error on a disk that then does not confirm (invariant 4)

transitions.label: check fails
transitions.when: a mount check fails

transitions.label: check passes
transitions.when: a mount check passes again; reconciliation first

transitions.label: second table of §10
transitions.when: ro, ads, nocase, iocharset, errors-continue, hibernated, casefold, ascii-ci, no-journal, ignore-case or other-marker

transitions.label: remounted
transitions.when: mounted again without what made it readonly

transitions.label: check fails
transitions.when: a mount check fails

transitions.label: disk remove --evacuate
transitions.when: `disk remove --evacuate` or `disk replace` set its state to draining

transitions.label: check fails
transitions.when: a mount check fails; draining again once it passes

transitions.label: check passes
transitions.when: a mount check passes, its state still draining

transitions.label: disk remove --yes
transitions.when: out of the configuration once nothing depends on it

transitions.label: disk fail
transitions.when: `disk fail`: failed even if it comes back

transitions.label: disk fail
transitions.when: `disk fail`

transitions.label: disk remove --yes
transitions.when: out of the configuration

transitions.label: listed again
transitions.when: the configuration lists it again

transitions.label: found
transitions.when: a walk finds a copy new to the catalog: a user's, never verified

transitions.label: queued
transitions.when: the plan queues a replicate job and its pending copy

transitions.label: create done
transitions.when: the operation create committed, or finished by a reprise

transitions.label: canceled
transitions.when: no longer kept or counted by the plan, or its job ended; never while its job is running

transitions.label: beyond the level
transitions.when: more copies count than the level, and this one is not kept

transitions.label: kept again
transitions.when: kept toward the level again

transitions.label: another modified
transitions.when: a modification of another copy, or a change of metadata it could not be given

transitions.label: another modified
transitions.when: a modification of another copy

transitions.label: in the trash, overwritten
transitions.when: its trash job done: the row stays, a pending copy with its replicate job

transitions.label: scrub mismatch
transitions.when: a chunk that does not match, read again past the cache, size and times unchanged

transitions.label: repaired or read right
transitions.when: a chunk repair, or a copy that reads right after all

transitions.label: quarantined
transitions.when: to the trash, quarantined or repaired whole

transitions.label: to the trash, or row dropped
transitions.when: deleted or renamed to the trash, or its row dropped by a decision Kept or Gone

transitions.label: pruned
transitions.when: `prune` or `balance` send it to the trash

transitions.label: deleted
transitions.when: its file deleted, or its row dropped

unentered.unavailable: in the closed list, kept as every value of version 1 is (§29.3), and read by the plan, the view and the alerts; but no transition of specs.md sets it, and no code writes it
